arid_sandy.name: Arid / Hyper-Sandy Desert
fatal_limiting_factors: Rapid percolation (0 water retention)
Severe organic matter and micronutrient leaching
Scorching surface temperature (>45°C)
High alkalinity and boron toxicity

primary_remediation.rationale: Permanently increases Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC) and creates water retention sponges in the sand.

primary_remediation.amendment: Heavy Surface Mulch (Straw / Shredded Plant Matter)
primary_remediation.rationale: Reduces direct solar evaporation by 75% and suppresses soil surface heating.
Directly irrigates root zones via osmotic seepage with zero surface evaporation loss.

coastal_saline.name: Coastal / Saline / Sodic Soil
fatal_limiting_factors: High Electrical Conductivity (EC > 6 dS/m) causing osmotic drought
Sodium ion (Na+) toxicity disrupting cellular potassium absorption
Dispersed soil structure choking root respiration
Chloride toxicity burning leaf margins

primary_remediation.rationale: Calcium ions (Ca2+) displace toxic Sodium (Na+) from clay surfaces, allowing sodium to be leached downward.

primary_remediation.dosage: 100-150 liters per m² across raised beds
primary_remediation.rationale: Flushes displaced soluble sodium chloride below the root rhizosphere.
Prevents capillary rise of brackish saline groundwater into the topsoil.

acidic_clay.name: Acidic Tropical Clay (Laterite / Ultisol)
fatal_limiting_factors: Soluble Aluminum (Al3+) and Manganese toxicity inhibiting root elongation
Severe chemical lockup of Phosphorus into insoluble Aluminum-Phosphate compounds
Heavy compaction causing waterlogging and anaerobic root conditions
Low base saturation (depleted calcium and magnesium)

primary_remediation.amendment: Agricultural Lime (Calcium Carbonate - CaCO3) or Dolomite
primary_remediation.rationale: Raises pH from 4.5 to 6.2, precipitating soluble toxic Al3+ into inert aluminum hydroxide.
Replenishes phosphorus in slow-release form; fungal hyphae bridge root absorption.
Breaks tight clay lattices, introducing micro-channels for oxygen and microbial aerobic life.

rocky_slope.name: Degraded / Eroded Rocky Mountainous Slope
fatal_limiting_factors: Shallow topsoil horizon unable to support taproots
Rapid torrential rainwater runoff and slope erosion
Intense diurnal temperature fluctuations and high UV index
Severe wind desiccation

primary_remediation.dosage: Swales dug along contour lines every 3m
primary_remediation.rationale: Harvests 90% of slope runoff and stops topsoil sediment loss.

primary_remediation.dosage: Planted along berm edges at 15cm spacing
primary_remediation.rationale: Dense massive 3m root system creates an underground living retaining wall.

primary_remediation.amendment: Compost Sheet Mulching & Soil Bladder Building
primary_remediation.dosage: 3 kg per m² of organic matter
primary_remediation.rationale: Artificially deepens the topsoil layer from 8cm to 25cm.

waterlogged_wetland.name: Waterlogged Silt Wetland / Peat Marsh
fatal_limiting_factors: Complete root rhizosphere anoxia (zero dissolved oxygen)
Accumulation of toxic reduced compounds (H2S and methane)
Pythium and Phytophthora fungal root rot epidemics
Cold soil temperature retarding seed germination

primary_remediation.dosage: Ditches 40cm deep sloped toward retention pond
primary_remediation.rationale: Rapidly drops gravitational water table below active root zone.
Elevates root zone into aerobic atmospheric contact while drawing moisture from below.
Restores structural macro-pore spaces for gas exchange.

crop_catalog.name: Cassava
crop_catalog.why_viable: Immune to acidic soils and low phosphorus; massive root starch yield even in degraded soil.
crop_catalog.failure_mitigation: Requires well-drained mounds to prevent root rot in heavy rain.

crop_catalog.name: Cowpea
crop_catalog.why_viable: Yields protein-rich edible young leaves in 22 days; symbiotic rhizobia restore nitrogen to dead soil.
crop_catalog.failure_mitigation: Harvest leaves selectively from outer branches to preserve pod development.

crop_catalog.name: Pearl Millet
crop_catalog.why_viable: C4 photosynthetic pathway allows high biomass production even at 45°C in hyper-arid sand.
crop_catalog.failure_mitigation: Thin seedlings early to avoid intra-plant water competition.

crop_catalog.name: Barley
crop_catalog.why_viable: Highest salt tolerance of all major agricultural grains; excludes sodium at root tonoplast.
crop_catalog.failure_mitigation: Must ensure adequate nitrogen and calcium to compete with sodium uptake.

crop_catalog.name: Grain Amaranth
crop_catalog.why_viable: Extremely fast growing; edible greens in 20 days; grain contains complete amino acid profile (high lysine).
crop_catalog.failure_mitigation: Protect tiny emerging seeds from heavy torrential washouts.

crop_catalog.name: Swamp Taro
crop_catalog.why_viable: Possesses internal aerenchyma tissue transporting atmospheric oxygen directly to submerged roots.
crop_catalog.failure_mitigation: Must boil corms thoroughly prior to consumption to break down calcium oxalate crystals.
